_about: REACH and food-contact (FCM) evidence in category 4 (added 2026-11 on client request). Art 5(4) applies 'without prejudice to' REACH Annex XVII and the FCM legislation; those obligations come from their own regulations, so in the PPWR TD these items are recommended evidence — the declaration is the minimum document, test reports support it.

C04-74: Art 5(4) applies without prejudice to REACH Annex XVII restrictions; REACH compliance is a separate legal obligation (Reg. (EC) 1907/2006) — a declaration is the minimum evidence in the TD
Art 5(4) 的适用不影响 REACH 附件 XVII 限制；REACH 符合性为另一项独立法定义务（(EC) 1907/2006）——技术文档中声明为最低证据
C04-75: Annex VII 2(f) test reports — supports the REACH declaration (C04-74) where a restriction is verified by testing
Annex VII 2(f) 测试报告——在需检测验证限制时支撑 REACH 声明（C04-74）
C04-76: Supporting documentation behind the food-contact declaration of compliance (C04-72) under Reg. (EC) 1935/2004 and specific measures; Annex VII 2(f)
依据 (EC) 1935/2004 及具体措施，食品接触符合性声明（C04-72）背后的支持文件；Annex VII 2(f)

summary: Upload a declaration (from you or your supplier) that the packaging and its components meet the REACH Annex XVII restrictions, and state whether any SVHC from the Candidate List is above 0.1 % w/w. The declaration is the minimum; add test reports under C04-75 where needed.
上传（由您或供应商出具的）声明，说明包装及其组件符合 REACH 附件 XVII 限制，并说明候选清单中是否有 SVHC 超过 0.1 % w/w。声明为最低要求；如需检测，在 C04-75 补充检测报告。
terms: List of restrictions on the manufacture, placing on the market and use of certain substances (e.g. phthalates, PAHs, nickel, azo dyes).
对特定物质（如邻苯二甲酸酯、PAH、镍、偶氮染料）生产、投放市场和使用的限制清单。
Substances of very high concern on the ECHA Candidate List; above 0.1 % w/w in an article triggers information duties (REACH Art 33).
ECHA 候选清单上的高度关注物质；物品中含量超过 0.1 % w/w 时触发信息传递义务（REACH Art 33）。
logic: Art 5(4) PPWR: the heavy-metal limit applies 'without prejudice to' REACH Annex XVII — both must be met.
PPWR Art 5(4)：重金属限值的适用“不影响”REACH 附件 XVII——两者均须满足。
The EU DoC lists other Union legislation the packaging complies with (Annex VIII point 5); a REACH declaration documents it in the TD.
欧盟 DoC 列明包装符合的其他欧盟法规（Annex VIII 第 5 点）；REACH 声明在技术文档中记录这一点。
info: Declaration number, issuer, date, components covered, SVHC statement (Candidate List version), restrictions checked.
声明编号、出具方、日期、覆盖组件、SVHC 说明（候选清单版本）、核查的限制条目。
recommended: Declaration ≤ 12 months old and referencing the current Candidate List
声明不超过 12 个月，并引用现行候选清单
Test report under C04-75 for restrictions relevant to the material (e.g. phthalates in PVC, PAHs in rubber / black plastics)
针对材料相关限制在 C04-75 提供检测报告（如 PVC 中邻苯二甲酸酯、橡胶 / 黑色塑料中 PAH）
steps: Ask each supplier of a component for a REACH declaration (Annex XVII + SVHC).
向每个组件供应商索取 REACH 声明（附件 XVII + SVHC）。
Upload it as DCL; enter number, issuer, date and the SVHC statement.
以 DCL 类型上传；填写编号、出具方、日期及 SVHC 说明。
Where a restriction must be verified by testing, add the report under C04-75.
如某项限制需检测验证，在 C04-75 补充报告。
good: REACH-DCL-2026-003 V1 · board supplier · 2026-09-01 · no SVHC > 0.1 % (Candidate List Jun 2026) · card, ink, adhesive.
REACH-DCL-2026-003 V1 · 纸板供应商 · 2026-09-01 · 无 SVHC > 0.1 %（候选清单 2026 年 6 月版）· 纸卡、油墨、胶黏剂。
bad: 'REACH compliant' on an invoice, no declaration.
仅在发票上写“符合 REACH”，没有声明。
SVHC statement against a Candidate List several years old.
SVHC 说明引用的是数年前的候选清单。

summary: Where a REACH restriction has to be verified by testing, upload the laboratory report and register its number, laboratory, date, substances tested and result.
如某项 REACH 限制需检测验证，上传实验室报告并登记编号、实验室、日期、检测物质及结果。
logic: Annex VII 2(f) lists test reports as TD content; this item is their landing place for REACH.
Annex VII 2(f) 将测试报告列为技术文档内容；本项是 REACH 报告的落点。
Not needed when the REACH declaration (C04-74) is adequately supported by supplier information.
如 REACH 声明（C04-74）已有供应商信息充分支持，则无需本项。
info: Report number, laboratory, date, substances / restrictions tested, components covered, result.
报告编号、实验室、日期、检测物质 / 限制条目、覆盖组件、结果。
minimum: 已填写报告编号与实验室
已注明检测物质及结论
recommended: Report ≤ 24 months old from an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited lab
报告不超过 24 个月，来自 ISO/IEC 17025 认可实验室
steps: Copy number, lab, date, substances tested and conclusion.
抄录编号、实验室、日期、检测物质及结论。
good: RE-2026-221 · accredited lab · 2026-08-20 · 18 phthalates + 8 PAHs in PP strap · all below Annex XVII limits.
RE-2026-221 · 认可实验室 · 2026-08-20 · PP 打包带中 18 种邻苯二甲酸酯 + 8 种 PAH · 均低于附件 XVII 限值。
bad: Screening report without the restriction entries it was checked against.
筛查报告未注明对照的限制条目。

summary: Food-contact packaging: upload the migration test report(s) behind the food-contact declaration of compliance (C04-72) — overall and specific migration, simulants, time and temperature.
食品接触包装：上传食品接触符合性声明（C04-72）背后的迁移检测报告——总迁移与特定迁移、模拟物、时间与温度。
terms: 总迁移 / 特定迁移（OM / SML）
Limits for the total and for individual substances transferring from the material into food simulants.
材料迁移至食品模拟物的总量及单个物质的限值。
logic: The declaration of compliance (C04-72) is the minimum document; the migration reports are its supporting documentation, kept available for the authorities (e.g. Reg. (EU) 10/2011 Art 16 for plastics).
符合性声明（C04-72）为最低文件；迁移报告是其支持文件，须备查以供主管机关查阅（如塑料适用 (EU) 10/2011 Art 16）。
info: Report number, laboratory, date, simulants / time / temperature, OM and SML results, conclusion.
报告编号、实验室、日期、模拟物 / 时间 / 温度、OM 与 SML 结果、结论。
minimum: 已填写报告编号与实验室
已注明测试条件与结果
recommended: Test conditions match the declared conditions of use in C04-72
测试条件与 C04-72 声明的使用条件一致
steps: 上传 PDF 迁移报告。
Copy number, lab, simulants / time / temperature and the results.
抄录编号、实验室、模拟物 / 时间 / 温度及结果。
good: FCM-MIG-2026-041 · accredited lab · simulants A, B, D2 · 10 days at 40 °C · OM < 10 mg/dm² · SMLs met.
FCM-MIG-2026-041 · 认可实验室 · 模拟物 A、B、D2 · 40 °C 10 天 · OM < 10 mg/dm² · 满足 SML。
bad: Migration test at 10 days 20 °C for a hot-fill application.
热灌装用途却只做了 20 °C 10 天迁移测试。
